output.reason: At 32 weeks pregnant with persistent headache, blurry vision and facial/hand puffiness, severe preeclampsia is sufficiently plausible to require immediate emergency obstetric assessment today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now (or your maternity unit's emergency service) — persistent headache, blurred vision and facial/hand swelling at 32 weeks can mean preeclampsia, which needs blood pressure, urine and blood testing right away. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. If you develop a seizure, fainting, severe belly pain or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately.
differential: Preeclampsia with severe features at 32 weeks
